responsibility: This header declares GCC's internationalization interface and the translation macros used throughout the compiler. It wraps locale and gettext availability, provides stubs when NLS is disabled, defines _, N_, and G_ marking macros, and declares initialization, width-query, spacing, and locale/quote globals used by diagnostics and other message-producing code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/intl.cc, which implements locale setup and translation-related helpers, this header is the compile-time interface layer that defines gettext/NLS wrapper macros, stubs, declarations, and exported locale-related globals.
